subject: Mutual Action Plan draft + exec approval request for FinVault POC
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Claire Evans <claire.evans@finvault.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + initial MAP (attached) — FinVault POC

Claire — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the draft Mutual Action Plan attached (FinVault-MAP-v1.3.docx). Highlights and asks below so we stay aligned on scope and timing.

High-level objective:
- 2-week controlled POC to validate latency and cost on customer traffic profile, followed by 30-day ramp to a pilot environment. Target: evaluate for production by mid-Jan.

Proposed MAP milestones (owners / target dates):
1) SOC2 evidence & security sign-off — FinVault / Redwood security exchange — target: 2026-12-06 (owner: Ruth Cheng / Marcus)
2) Network & VPC peering test — Redwood infra -> FinVault staging — target: 2026-12-09 (owner: Redwood eng / FinVault infra)
3) POC kickoff (2 weeks) — 2026-12-13 to 2026-12-27 (owner: FinVault product / Marcus)
4) Pilot evaluation & decision — target: 2027-01-15 (owner: FinVault execs / Marissa)

Dependencies: SOC2 reports, procurement PO, committed monthly spend for pilot (see pricing ask below).

Pricing/credits request (from FinVault discussion today):
- FinVault requested a set of onboarding credits to offset POC costs and a short-term usage credit if they commit to a 12-month reserved level after pilot. We discussed a one-time onboarding credit plus a usage credit tied to a commit.

Immediate asks for FinVault: please confirm (by EOD Thu) if the target POC start window (12/13) works and confirm primary infra contact for peering (Ruth referenced above).

Next steps from our side: Marcus will circulate an updated MAP that includes a draft pricing/credit proposal for internal review and exec approval. Marissa will coordinate demo scheduling and instrumentation for latency metrics. Laura — tagging you for any initial thoughts on pricing flexibility; we'll need a quick decision on the commit threshold for credits.

Attachments: FinVault-MAP-v1.3.docx (MAP with milestone table), FinVault-POC-costs-commit-breakdown.xlsx (cost model).

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin

From: Claire Evans <claire.evans@finvault.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + initial MAP (attached) — FinVault POC

Marcus — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming the POC window looks good on our side, pending SOC2 evidence. Ruth will be the primary infra contact for peering; she copied above.

A couple of clarifying notes:
- On credits: our procurement and finance teams need a clearer view of the offset for the POC. For budget reasons we asked internally for a ~20% usage credit during the POC and a one-time onboarding credit applied to the first invoice if we convert to reserved within 30 days of pilot.
- On commit: our CFO wants to see a committed monthly baseline for the reserved tier (we were thinking 30k/month) tied to the credit.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the 20% POC usage credit and a one-time onboarding credit conditional on a 12-month commit at the 30k/month level? If that requires exec approval, please let us know the timeline — procurement is pushing to have terms by mid-December.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Evans

Laura — quick heads up on FinVault's formal ask below. Summary of the requested commercial concession: 1) 20% usage credit during the 2-week POC; 2) one-time onboarding credit (requested amount: $50k) if FinVault converts to a 12-month reserved commit at $30k/month within 30 days of pilot. Procurement wants terms by ~2026-12-15.

We believe FinVault is a strategic mid-market account (security-first, good long-term ARR potential). Marissa is preparing the MAP edits. Asking for fast-track exec review: can we approve the following options?

Option A (preferred by FinVault):
- 20% POC usage credit (applied to POC invoice)
- $50k onboarding credit if FinVault signs 12mo @ $30k/mo within 30 days of pilot

Option B (conservative):
- 10% POC usage credit
- $25k onboarding credit with the same conversion condition

Notes for finance: committing to $30k/month for 12 months yields $360k ARR — with our gross margin profile the credits are expected to be payback-positive if conversion occurs. Attachment: FinVault-POC-costs-commit-breakdown.xlsx (detailed model).

Could you confirm decision or route to final approver? If you want, I can draft the short approval thread and a DocuSign-ready amendment.

Thanks — Marcus

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: FinVault pricing/credit ask — initial exec response

Marcus — thanks for the clear options and model. Given the timeline and strategic profile, I'm willing to provisionally approve Option B with one condition: finance needs to sign off on the $25k onboarding credit and we should require a minimum 9-month commit if they do not reach the $30k/month threshold within the first 30 days. This reduces downside while keeping the conversion incentive.

Concrete direction:
- Approve Option B (10% POC credit + $25k onboarding credit) subject to Finance sign-off.
- Require legal to prepare a short amendment with the conversion clause (30 days to convert to 12mo@30k/mo, fallback: 9mo minimum at pro-rated level).
- Marcus/Marissa: please update the MAP timeline to reflect a procurement deadline of 2026-12-15 and get DocuSign edits ready.

Dylan — can you prioritize a quick finance review? If you need a modeling tweak, Marcus has the spreadsheet.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

- Onboarding credit: $25,000 one-time credit applied if FinVault converts to a 12-month reserved commit; fallback: 9-month minimum if the 30-day conversion window is missed
- Target POC kickoff: 2026-12-13 (SOC2 evidence and peering tests remain blockers — Ruth, Marcus will coordinate)
- Procurement deadline for signed amendment (DocuSign): 2026-12-15

1) Marissa will send an updated MAP (v1.4) with the revised commercial language and milestone table by EOD tomorrow.
2) Marcus will share the DocuSign amendment draft as soon as Legal/Finance sign off (aiming for 48h).
3) FinVault to confirm peering contact and SOC2 evidence delivery date (Ruth).

If this is acceptable, we can schedule a 30-min procurement kickoff this week to align contacts and the DocuSign timeline.
